senses.gloss: pr. n.B’ditha, name of a canal of the Euphrates, v. פּוּמְבְּדִיתָא.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:14">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ לבאי כוורי</he> (read <he>בב׳</he>, Alf. <he>בפומבדיתא</he>) in the B’ditha the fish were laid dry. [Var. <cite ref="B01286"><he>בריתא</he></cite>, <he>ברייתא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300.]
